parsed.root_cause: A Chaos Mesh network partition experiment targeting the shipping service is actively causing high latency and request errors in the otel-demo namespace.
evidence: Kubernetes events show a Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' was forbidden from spawning new jobs because an instance 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-5vv7v' was still running.
Kubernetes events confirm a NetworkChaos resource named 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-kx8th' has been initialized with finalizers.
Alerts indicate severe latency (over 9 seconds) and error rates for the 'shipping' and 'checkout' services in the 'otel-demo' namespace, which are consistent with network partition symptoms.
